exposure: implementation processes for MNH policy and practice
government focus on peace and stabilization
fragmented parallel systems run by international actors
outcome: stagnating investments in maternal and newborn health (MNH)
cohort: A total of 20 key informants from government, humanitarian and development organizations, civil society, donors, and health providers in South Sudan were interviewed.
finding: Despite MNH being a policy priority, financial investment is inadequate due to government focus on peace, fragmented international systems, conflicts, disease outbreaks, and gendered attitudes, leading to significant implementation gaps.
cross-section timing: Data collected through interviews with current stakeholders at the time of the study.
